name: Maestro
summary: Mobile UI testing with flows written in YAML, built-in tolerance for delays and a fast edit-and-rerun loop.
strengths: Flows are short YAML files that anyone on the team can read.
Waits for the UI to settle automatically.
Very quick to get the first journey running.
tradeoffs: YAML flows have limited abstraction for large suites.
Less control over low-level device behavior than Appium.
